answer: That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that forfeits. The inlet counter is kept in sonnet and mirror shows each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 5 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 382 aliases cost 123 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
